label: Убрать бесполезный Chrome Consent watcher и фоновые расходы
description: Исправить legacy ChatGPT CDP prompt watcher: no background timer, default-off, one-shot compatibility scan only, preserve page-level modal auto-answer and document Chrome-owned consent boundary.
acceptance: Focused chatgpt-mac-cdp-driver tests, tsc and diff-check pass; source commit integrated into main; no setInterval remains for prompt watcher and normal page operations still scan/answer page-level modal prompts.
result: Commit 1838175e integrated into main. Focused Vitest 56/56 passed, tsc --noEmit passed, Rust lib 203/203 passed, diff-check passed. TDD RED/GREEN evidence and bug B8795931e39974cc68818 fixed. Full npm test remains red on 44 unrelated baseline/foreign failures, including pre-existing duplicate imports and missing browser fixture bindings; no Consent test failure.
